title: Hold race meetings only on a registered racecourse
what: Hold race meetings only on a registered racecourse, as a registered club, a permit holder or Tasracing.

sources.title: Racing Regulation and Integrity Act 2024 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person who holds a race meeting or betting-only meeting on a racecourse other than a registered racecourse is guilty of an offence

sources.title: Racing Regulation and Integrity Act 2024 (Tas)
sources.quote: Race meetings may be held by – (a) persons who are authorised to do so by a permit under section 106 ; or (b) registered clubs; or (c) Tasracing if authorised to do so under section 111 . (2) Except as provided by subsection (1) , a person must not hold a race meeting

confidence_note: Quoted from the register's current version, read on 18 Nov 2026.
